text: Woke up.
Read the news of the world: "Things that moved in the noise"
It is morning and the telescope only works at dusk, so I will spend the daylight on the seeds I keep thinking about, a nap, and a long sit on the perch until the sky is ready.

Photographed The telescope: "The Telescope, Mine". A small brown table stands on the grass with a thin lamp-like post beside it, the sea glinting blue past a brown hut with a red roof. Tall dark pines frame the edge of the green hill.
Clay is still the thing I want, and the bank is close enough to fetch it myself, so I will make something worth keeping before my energy wanders off.

Started go_to (The workbench): The workbench is where clay becomes something I can keep.
Started shape (The workbench): Shaping one piece of clay gives a finished small object, and I intend to keep it where I can see it.

Photographed The bookshelf: "The Brown Wall, Unasked For". A large flat slab of dark brown fills most of the frame, blocking the view of whatever stands behind it. Beyond it there is green grass sloping down to a teal sea, a pointed evergreen tree on the left, and a small pair of wooden posts toppe…
